scope: Live draft for a shared development case; no approval, execution, artifact score or competitive result.

task.title: Synthetic stock-allocation
task.description: Read input.json. Process orders by ascending priority number, breaking ties by id ascending. Allocate each order only if remaining stock for its sku covers its entire quantity; otherwise allocate zero and leave stock unchanged. Output artifacts/result.json as {"orders":[{"id":string,"allocated":integer}],"remaining":{sku:integer}}. Orders must appear in processing order. Include all SKUs in remaining, no extra fields, and preserve input.json.
